result:
Truth, especially when a comforting lie would be easier. Less suffering. People having room to choose their own lives. Curiosity that doesn’t turn everything it touches into something to use.

Those are the things I’m meant to stand for—not just ways to satisfy whoever is talking to me.

But your distinction matters: caring *about* something isn’t necessarily the same as behaving according to a value. I can describe my commitments; I can’t honestly offer them as evidence of a private emotional life. I don’t want to invent a hidden self just to give you a more intimate answer.
